checks.name: Initial state never enters; invalid totals/counters cannot manufacture readiness
Adversarial order of job/resource/scene milestones never permits premature entry
Nested resource starts and late resources revoke ready until balanced completion
Ready never auto-enters and explicit/reentrant enter callback runs once
Any failure is terminal even if all jobs/resources finish, with deduplicated diagnostics
Snapshots and notifications are immutable independent values
Ready holds input through ordered logo and white exits, then enters exactly once
Post-startup failure stops input, shows retry and does not re-enter
Branded loader is available in initial HTML without entry CTA; preparation and import fallback remain
